spans.s: वेग m. 1. Impetuosity, speed, velocity; 2. impetus, impulse; 3. stream, current, यथा नदीनां बहवोम्बुवेगाः Bg.xi.28; 4. force, power, strength, कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगम् Bg.v.22; 5. the flight of an arrow, Kir.xiii.24; 6. haste, rashness; 7. love, passion; 8. pleasure, delight; 9. semen virile; 10. evacuation of the feces.
वेग-अनिल m. 1. breeze caused by velocity; 2. violent gust.
वेग-आघात m. 1. check; 2. obstruction of the feces.
वेगिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Swift, fleet, rapid.
वेगिन् (II) m. 1. A courier; 2. a hawk.
